responses: To report a VAWC concern or initiate intake documentation, please navigate to 'Services' > 'VAWC' or visit the Barangay 183 VAW Desk in person. Notice: The online portal provides intake recording assistance only; formal case assessment and the issuance of Barangay Protection Orders (BPO) are conducted solely by the Punong Barangay or authorized Barangay Kagawad in accordance with RA 9262. In an emergency, dial 911 or PNP WCPC at 177 immediately. (Para mag-record ng reklamo, pumunta sa 'Services' > 'VAWC' o personal na magtungo sa Barangay VAW Desk.
